name: annStrata STR direct model
scope: autosomes and chrX (a haploid call is scored as a homozygous call, as in training); chrY/chrM records are not scored
inputs: ExpansionHunter / DRAGEN Repeat Genotyper VCF (or ExpansionHunter caller table): REPCN, REPCI, SO, ADSP/ADFL/ADIR, LC, FILTER, INFO RU; sample-level LC median/MAD
truth: TRGT AL (bp), same catalog, HPRC 274 genomes
training_rows: one row per allele; shorter/longer allele by REPCN order (feature rank); partner-allele values as features

endpoints.error_probability: P(|EH length - T| > max(1 RU, 0.5 x T)), T = long-read length; LightGBM binary classifier + global isotonic calibration (fitted on sample-split OOF)
endpoints.corrected_length: median and 80% interval of T (bp) = max(EH,1) x 2^r at the 0.5 / 0.1 / 0.9 quantiles of r = log2(max(T,1)/max(EH,1)); three LightGBM quantile regressors; quantiles sorted per allele

early_stopping: 10% of samples held out (seed 0), patience 50, max 10000 rounds

calibration.fitted_on: sample-split OOF of run lgbm_direct (95,467,444 alleles, autosomes + chrX, 274 samples)

feature_code: features.py (same definitions as software/annstrata/annstrata/str_features.py; parity with the training matrix: scripts/check_feature_parity.py)
validation: 5-fold CV, sample-group and 10-Mb block splits reported side by side: cv/lgbm_direct/REPORT.md, CALIBRATION.md
